text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm here with some of the best runners<n>around to
ask them their thoughts on<n>their careers. Starting
off...

text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
text_block_list.text:
The races I have run ere comprise only<n>the
introduction to my career. Thus, the<n>proverbial
die has been cast!

text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
text_block_list.text:
Now pay close attention! I will charge<n>like Julius
Caesar through the<n>battlefield. I must present the
luster of<n>the Overlord to the masses!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: In other words, you're ready to go! I see,<n>I see...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And now, I'd like to hear your opinion,<n>Zenno
Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Well, u-um! I'm n-not sure what to say...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ah, please, no need to be nervous. You<n>can relax.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
According to my notes, you admire Rob<n>Roy
MacGregor, a notable hero in<n>history... Could you
elaborate as to why?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you know about Rob Roy<n>MacGregor, the
Scottish legend of<n>yore?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I do admire him! As a bearer of the<n>same
name, I strive to not tarnish his<n>legacy. He was a
man who stood up for<n>the weak!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of him, I'm generally interested<n>in books
of his heroic tales that have<n>shaped his image
until today. One of my<n>favorites would be...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
text_block_list.text: Oh, Opera O! Why must I be Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
text_block_list.text:
This eternal question comes with an<n>answer. As I
continue to stare inwards at<n>mine own self, at
last... a ray of hope is<n>found!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course, comparing historical figures<n>to their
literary interpretations can<n>reveal certain
deviations from truth. But<n>if you only consider
those stories a mere<n>fraction of real history...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This sudden surge of information would<n>
overwhelm even the great listener,<n>Prince
Shotoku!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Otonashi skillfully draws out the<n>Umamusume's
thoughts and passions,<n>resulting in an exciting
and dynamic<n>interview!
